scope: Executed copied-decoder workloads after native capture, with raw compiler/output and original extraction failure preserved. Counterfactual field order and artificial chunking are labeled; no model/service latency isolation is claimed.

benchmark.profile: debug, isolated crate with pinned existing serde/serde_json versions
benchmark.scope: Exact copied decoder functions from the captured diagnostic source. Largest nonempty retained answer from each completed hour, without correctness filtering. Synthetic chunks of one, eight and sixty-four Unicode scalar values are delivered synchronously without network delays; original raw chunking is unavailable. Text-first ordering is a counterfactual stress case, not an observed provider order. Instant measures wall time including OS scheduling, not CPU-accounted processor time. Three sequential repetitions and shared machine resources do not establish provider latency or a population percentile.
